summary: Iteration 10 focused on frontend micro-interactions + dark-mode audit + UPI deep links. UPI deep links, cursor follower, magnetic buttons, and animated logo all work correctly. However, three DARK-MODE-AUDIT REGRESSIONS were found: (a) Booking Modal renders with light background & near-invisible text; (b) Admin dashboard stat counters render dark text (#1A1A1A) on dark card (#1a1a1e) making them invisible; (c) Admin booking-filter tabs (Pending/Confirmed/Completed/Cancelled) render white text on white background. Backend was not touched this iteration and no backend testing was performed (only frontend regression checks, per request).

ui_bugs.issue: Dialog panel renders with LIGHT background in dark mode (data-theme='dark'). Title 'Book Appointment', step labels (Services/Stylist/Date & Time/Details/Confirm), and 'Running Total' text are near-invisible. The DialogContent uses default shadcn white bg and no dark override.

Stat numbers (12/10/2/0) render color rgb(26,26,26) on bg rgb(26,26,30) — completely invisible in dark mode. Likely a hardcoded text-[#1A1A1A] on .text-4xl not covered by the dark-mode CSS override block.
Filter chips 'Pending / Confirmed / Completed / Cancelled' show computed color rgb(255,255,255) on background rgb(255,255,255) — invisible white-on-white in dark mode.

The 'UPI ID' quick-copy block (bg-[#FBF3E6] with text-[#1A1A1A]) keeps a light cream surface even in dark mode. Text is still readable (dark on cream), but visually inconsistent with the rest of the dark-mode checkout. bg-[#FBF3E6] was not part of the audit's dark-invert list.

action_items: Add dark-mode override for shadcn DialogContent (BookingModal + AuthModal) — currently the panel uses default white bg. Add [data-theme='dark'] .DialogContent { background: #0F0F11; color: #FDFBF7; } or similar targeted rule.
Fix admin dashboard KPI counter text color in dark mode — .text-4xl inside stat cards resolves to #1A1A1A on dark card bg (invisible). Add dark override or use text-[#FDFBF7] dark:text-[#FDFBF7].
Fix admin booking filter tabs (Pending/Confirmed/Completed/Cancelled) — active/inactive states resolve to white-on-white in dark mode.
Consider adding bg-[#FBF3E6] to the dark-mode CSS invert list so the UPI-ID quick-copy panel matches the rest of the dark checkout surface.
critical_code_review_comments: Checkout.jsx magnetic Place Order strength=0.25 radius=90 — good; but the button is a full-width bar 100% wide, so magnetic pull will drag its left edge visibly off-screen at large offsets. Consider clamping translate to +-8px.

CursorFollower uses two fixed divs at z-9999/9998 with mix-blend-difference. On heavy pages this creates a repaint on every mousemove; consider throttling or using pointer-events:none which is already set.

Dark mode CSS in index.css uses !important on many rules — acceptable given tailwind inline classes, but shadcn Dialog is portalled to <body> so must target [data-theme='dark'] on <html> combined with descendant selectors OR the portal root won't inherit — this is likely the root cause of the BookingModal light-panel bug.

rca of the issue: shadcn Dialog uses a React portal that mounts into document.body outside the app tree. The dark-mode CSS overrides in index.css use hardcoded utility-class selectors (e.g. .bg-white when [data-theme='dark']) that likely don't cascade into the portalled dialog because the portal element is a sibling of <#root>, but data-theme is set on <html> so it should still work. The observed light BookingModal panel suggests either (a) the shadcn DialogContent uses `bg-background` (a CSS var) which doesn't match .bg-white selector, or (b) the invert rule uses a specificity that loses to shadcn's own bg-background rule. Recommend adding explicit `[data-theme='dark'] [role='dialog'] { background-color: #0F0F11 !important; color: #FDFBF7 !important; }` and cascading into inputs.
